verdict.rationale: Termius's docs explicitly describe saving IPs, ports, and passwords so hosts connect instantly without re-entering credentials, backed by Keychain-based credential reuse and cross-device sync (termius-docs-1, termius-docs-3, termius-docs-19, termius-docs-22). Community reviews corroborate everyday use of saved hosts/snippets for quick admin tasks and praise it as a top-tier SSH client (termius-comm-1, termius-comm-14), though some users raise security concerns about credential storage rather than disputing the one-tap functionality itself. Missing for 10: a hands-on independent test specifically confirming the 'one tap, no re-entry' flow end-to-end, and resolution of Windows performance complaints that could affect the tap-to-connect experience.
